policy: Only individually reviewed display string literals; original code and shared values remain byte-identical.

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Ready to bridge calls to the PBX"
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "已就绪，可以将通话桥接至 PBX"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Gateway off; this app remains the default phone app"
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关已关闭；本应用仍是默认电话应用"
"网关已关闭；请检查电话应用是否已恢复"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Gateway off; calls stay with your dialer"
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关已关闭；通话由原电话应用处理"
"Android 11 不支持与原电话应用并行访问通话"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Enable takeover to make this app the default phone app."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "开启通话接管以将本应用设为默认电话应用。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "This app stays the default when takeover is off."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "关闭通话接管后，本应用仍保持为默认电话应用。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Turning takeover off tries to restore your previous phone app."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "关闭通话接管时，会尝试恢复之前的电话应用。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Default dialer selection is unavailable on this device."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "此设备无法选择默认电话应用。"
"在系统设置中选择电话应用"
"尝试将本机听筒或扬声器静音"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Playback muting cannot be attempted with the current setup. The phone microphone remains muted during gateway calls. Changes apply to the next call."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "当前配置无法尝试将播放声音静音。网关通话期间，手机麦克风始终静音。更改在下次通话生效。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Muting stopped direct telephony audio on this phone, so it is skipped when that method is used. Turn this off and on again to retest."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "静音导致本机的直连通话音频中断，因此使用该方式时会跳过静音。关闭并重新开启此选项可再次测试。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "When enabled, attempts to silence the earpiece or speaker. The phone microphone remains muted during gateway calls. Changes apply to the next call."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "开启后会尝试将听筒或扬声器静音。网关通话期间，手机麦克风始终静音。更改在下次通话生效。"
"更改将在所有通话结束后生效"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Health checks will start after current calls end."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "所有通话结束后开始状态检查。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Health checks are paused while takeover is off."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "关闭通话接管期间暂停状态检查。"
"已加入 Doze 省电白名单"
"当前音频方式：${if (callAudio.available) callAudio.backendLabel else "状态不可用"}"
"下次通话：本机播放静音${if (cur.muteEarpiece) "已请求" else "关闭"}。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Local call playback restoration is unconfirmed. Sound may remain muted."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "尚未确认本机通话声音已恢复，可能仍处于静音状态。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "If call sound stays muted, raise the call volume during a normal phone call."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "如果通话仍无声音，请在普通电话通话中调高通话音量。"
"蜂窝来电回声测试（不桥接 PBX）"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "While the gateway is on, answers incoming cellular calls and echoes the caller's audio instead of connecting the PBX. Changes apply after the current call ends."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关开启时，接听蜂窝来电并将声音回传给来电方，不连接 PBX。更改在当前通话结束后生效。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Android 11 requires this app as the default phone app."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "Android 11 要求将本应用设为默认电话应用。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Works alongside your phone app unless this app is the default."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "本应用不是默认电话应用时，与原电话应用并行运行。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Restore your usual phone app to use this mode."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "请先恢复常用电话应用，再使用此模式。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Enable takeover or tap Make default phone app to switch."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "开启通话接管，或点击“设为默认电话应用”进行切换。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Keep this app as the default phone app when gateway is off"
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关关闭时仍将本应用保留为默认电话应用"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "When disabled, turning takeover off tries to restore your previous phone app."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "关闭此选项后，关闭通话接管时会尝试恢复之前的电话应用。"
"在系统设置中选择电话应用"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Manual dialer selection leaves takeover unchanged. Selecting Default dialer above applies to the next switch-on."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "手动选择电话应用不会改变通话接管开关。上方选择的“默认电话应用”模式将在下次开启时应用。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Prefers cellular call redirection; falls back to direct telephony during setup."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "优先使用蜂窝通话重定向；配置时若不可用，则回退至直连通话音频。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Uses direct cellular audio capture and playback, without redirection fallback."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "直接采集和播放蜂窝通话音频，不回退至重定向方式。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Uses cellular call redirection only. Requires Android 13+ and privileged access."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "仅使用蜂窝通话重定向，需要 Android 13 或更高版本及特权访问权限。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: " Changes apply to the next call."
"Audio access and frame counters do not verify remote delivery. Verify both directions on this device."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "具备音频权限和帧计数并不能证明远端收到音频，请在本机验证双向通话。"
"SIP 域（留空则使用 PBX 主机地址）"
"蜂窝来电转接至 SIP 目标（留空使用用户名）"
"允许外拨的号码前缀（英文逗号分隔，留空不限）"
"更改将在所有通话结束后生效"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Saved changes apply after the current call ends."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "已保存的更改在当前通话结束后生效。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Saved SIP settings are used when takeover is next enabled."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "已保存的 SIP 设置将在下次开启通话接管时使用。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Unregister while the phone cannot take calls"
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "手机无法处理网关通话时暂停 SIP 注册"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "At startup, waits for the phone to be ready before registering with the PBX. "
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "启动时等待手机就绪，再向 PBX 注册。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Later problems get ${GatewayRuntime.SIP_HOLD_GRACE_MS / 1000} s to recover before unregistering so the PBX can fail over. "
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "后续出现问题时，将等待 ${GatewayRuntime.SIP_HOLD_GRACE_MS / 1000} 秒尝试恢复，再注销注册，以便 PBX 切换备用线路。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Registration changes wait for calls to end; registers again as soon as the phone is ready."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "注册状态的更改会等待通话结束；手机就绪后立即重新注册。"
"记录 Info 级别日志，号码已脱敏"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Gateway will turn off after current calls end."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关将在所有通话结束后关闭。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Gateway will turn on after current calls end."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关将在所有通话结束后开启。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Waiting for current calls to end before changing the dialer."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "等待所有通话结束后切换电话应用。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Gateway is off. Switch to your usual dialer to handle calls."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关已关闭，请切换至常用电话应用处理通话。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Gateway is ready to bridge calls through the PBX."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关已就绪，可以通过 PBX 桥接通话。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Gateway is unavailable. Open configuration or switch to your usual dialer."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "网关不可用，请打开配置或切换至常用电话应用。"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "For manual calls, restore your usual phone app or choose one in system Settings."
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "如需手动拨号，请恢复常用电话应用，或在系统设置中选择电话应用。"
"在系统设置中选择电话应用"

app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.original: "Open gateway status or switch dialer for recovery"
app/src/main/kotlin/io/github/sparkcyf/v.translated: "打开网关状态，或切换电话应用以恢复通话"
